purpose: Curation record for screens/targets-0.5.json (the loadable manifest). Every row was verified twice against the HF API (curation agent, then an independent re-verification agent; both 2026-07-24), then corrected on the main thread. This file is the audit trail; the manifest is what `quantfit screen` consumes.
revision_semantics: repo_revision records the repo's main commit AT CURATION TIME, verified sha-for-sha. quantfit's hf: loader resolves whatever main points at when the screen runs and records the RESOLVED commit in each report's arm revision — compare it to the pin here after the run. The pin is a verification record, not an enforced input (gguf_arm._fetch passes no revision=).

caps.gguf: unquantized baseline file <= 16.5 GB on disk (~8B-class) — the binding constraint is RAM for the F16 arm
caps.compressed-tensors: <= 3B params in-GPU on 12 GB VRAM; transformers-loadable quantized checkpoints (compressed-tensors format or AWQ)

disk_note: 129.49 GB total vs ~38 GB free at curation: prune by tier (C first) or clean the 0.4b artifacts before the hunt. Tiers: A = never prune (cheap/high-signal), B = mid, C = prune first.

excluded.reason: REMOVED AFTER VERIFICATION (was on the original list): the declared base mistralai/Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512 is itself FP8-quantized (quant_method=fp8; 78.6% of params stored F8_E4M3), so the 'BF16' GGUF is an upcast of quantized weights, not an unquantized baseline — the diff would measure FP8->Q4_K_M while labeled unquantized-vs-Q4_K_M, and the GGUF file_type guard (ftype 32 = BF16) cannot catch it. It is also a VLM (Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration, separate mmproj files), the same rule that excluded UI-TARS. Lesson recorded: curation must check the BASE model's quantization_config; the file's own metadata is necessary but not sufficient.
